name: InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd.
summary: InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of thin film transistor liquid crystal display panels in China and internationally. Its products include laptops, desktop monitors, cars, mobile phones, vehicle display, and tablet display panels, as well as smart home panels. In addition, the company offers industrial control product display and automotive products, including automobile manufacturers. InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kunshan, China.
